Toddler meals

Soft beef patties

Házi húspogácsa

10 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Cut the meat into squat pieces and serve with soft bread and tomato. Skip a salty bun and skip ketchup. The patty alone is gluten-free.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 300 g Minced beef (Plain mince, not cured or seasoned)
  • 1 small Onion (Finely grated)
  • 2 slices Soft bread (For serving; the patty itself has no wheat)
  • 1 medium Tomato (Peeled and chopped soft)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mix the beef with the grated onion and shape four soft patties.
  3. Bake until the centre is cooked through and no longer pink, about 18 minutes.
  4. Rest, then cut the meat into squat pieces.
  5. Serve with small pieces of soft bread and the tomato.

Adjusted

A salty bun and ketchup are left off, and no salt goes into the meat. Ten months is the age because of the bread, not because the patty must wait that long on its own.

Bake a soft beef and grated-onion patty and serve it in pieces with soft bread and tomato. The patty alone is gluten-free; gluten comes from the bread. Cut the meat into squat pieces.
